answer_1.quote: We propose a low-cost, task-level INDUCT-LEARN framework that can effectively improve performance using only a few demonstrations and a very simple short phrase to limit the scope.
answer_1.outputs: The framework generates pseudo instructions and chain-of-thought (CoT) processes to improve LLM performance on unseen tasks.

answer_2.quote: Given the instructions generated by different methods and the question, we calculate the accuracy of the results that LLMs generate.
